_help: Copy to config.json (same folder) and keep only what you change. Every key is optional: without config.json the mod finds Python on PATH (Windows: pythonw, python, py; elsewhere python3, python), runs the scripts in py/, and reads the state file where the collector writes it. Keys starting with _help are notes and are ignored.
_help_paths: Absolute paths of the programs; null = found by the mod. Set python when it is not on PATH (e.g. "C:/Python312/pythonw.exe"). collector / office_script: default <herdr-app>/mods/hakoniwa/py/hakoniwa-collector.py and hakoniwa-office.py. state_dir / state: where the collector writes state.json (default %LOCALAPPDATA%/hakoniwa; set them together with the collector's --out only if you move it).
_help_demo: demo: true starts with the made-up cast (also: herdr-app do hakoniwa.demo). demo_args: extra collector arguments for the demo, e.g. ["--demo-size", "40", "--demo-spaces", "8"].

office._help_sources: What is collected. true: always, false: never, "auto": only when that program is on this PC. app = Herdr App (herdr-core), t3 = T3 Code, tui = herdr TUI.
office._help_rooms: Rooms from the top. key: an id; title: the name on the floor; sources: which boxes go in; match: {"app": "codex"} puts only that kind of agent of the App in this room (rooms with match are decided first). A room with nobody in it is not drawn.
office._help_auto_rooms: true: a room lives with its people. The office closes a Herdr space 6 s after the last agent it saw there is gone and no terminal is left in it, names a new space after its first agent, and moves a leader's team into one space. false: it never closes, renames or moves anything by itself.
office._help_people: walk8: the 8-frame walk; walk_frames: false shows one picture with a bob instead of stepping the walking pictures.
office._help_weather: The wall board and the window show the weather from Open-Meteo (free, no key), asked by the collector at most every 30 minutes. No place given: a city chosen from the PC's timezone. place: a city name, looked up once. lat / lon: exact (beats place). label: the name on the board. enabled: false never asks.
office._help_board: The LED board on the wall: rows of dots (its width follows the room unless set).
office._help_colors: people.mode "list" picks each person's jacket / hair / skin from the lists (null: the built-in lists) by the agent's id; "generate" makes them from the ranges. chair / floor: a HEX colour or null. states and ui: the colours of the four states and of the panels.
office._help_sheets: The art: a folder with the same file names as py/sheets (or {"dir": folder, "room": file, ...}). The pieces are cut again when the files change.
office._help_launch: How agents started from the office begin. kinds.<kind>.argv replaces the start words of claude / codex / opencode / cursor / agy (the default is each CLI by itself, with no permission widened). Example for Codex with workspace writes: ["codex", "-s", "workspace-write"]. claude_settings.persist: every Claude started here gets a --settings file that sets CLAUDE_CODE_FORCE_SESSION_PERSISTENCE=1 (so its conversation can be shown); effort: a chosen effort is also put in that file (CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL), so it wins over an effort set in your own settings.json.
